network_access: Read-only web browsing; no publisher messages, signups or purchases

sources.title: Semantics-aware Exploration and Inspection Path Planning
sources.venue: ICRA 2023; acceptance stated by authors on arXiv
sources.access_scope: Original submitted paper full HTML, sections III and IV; author-submitted metadata
verified_claims: Three behaviors combine volumetric exploration, semantic mesh hole coverage and semantic inspection.
Segmented point clouds are assumed; prior semantic shape, size, location and prior map are not assumed.
Inspection includes image resolution and viewing-angle constraints.
limitations: No original-system reproduction or empirical superiority claim follows from a common CPU mechanism adaptation.

sources.title: Semantics-aware Predictive Inspection Path Planning
sources.access_scope: Original paper full HTML, abstract and semantic scene graph / modified SUBDUE sections; original author lab publication list for journal and DOI
verified_claims: Semantic scene graphs support repeated-pattern identification and prediction of unobserved structure.
The work presents two inspection planners.
The author lab lists the journal and DOI.
limitations: No unverified volume or page numbers added.
The use of semantic structure prediction is prior art, not a new general principle of this project.

sources.title: VISTA: Open-Vocabulary, Task-Relevant Robot Exploration with Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting
sources.access_scope: Original paper full HTML, sections III and IV
verified_claims: Assumes RGB-D and reliable pose estimates for online semantic 3DGS.
Voxel records of previously observed directions support viewpoint-diversity gain combined with semantic task relevance.
Planning samples candidate trajectories and executes a receding-horizon policy.
limitations: Only the inspected 2025 preprint version is dated here; this is not a claim that no later journal version exists.
A CPU mechanism comparator is not the complete VISTA online semantic 3DGS system.

sources.title: Planning and Acting in Partially Observable Stochastic Domains
sources.access_scope: Original author-hosted PDF; belief-state and finite planning sections
verified_claims: Belief states summarize observation and action history for partially observable decision making.
Finite policy trees can condition subsequent actions on observations.
limitations: The present finite proxy planner is not a new POMDP inference principle or a general exact POMDP solver.

sources.title: Sampling-based Robotic Information Gathering Algorithms
sources.venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research
sources.access_scope: Publisher abstract and metadata; full proof not inspected
verified_claims: The objective maximizes a robot information metric subject to a prespecified resource budget.
Three sampling-based information-gathering planners combine sampling and branch-and-bound ideas.
limitations: No complete proof was read in this verification.
No theoretical guarantee is transferred to the project.

sources.title: Adaptive Submodularity: Theory and Applications in Active Learning and Stochastic Optimization
sources.access_scope: Original author-submitted abstract/revision note and full HTML theorem 13
verified_claims: Adaptive greedy guarantees require corresponding adaptive submodularity conditions.
Revision v5 narrows the theorem 13 coverage guarantee and adds stronger conditions.
limitations: No submodularity or greedy approximation guarantee is asserted for the project product objective.
